NavigationPolicy.description: Rules for which domains a browser session may navigate to. Bind a policy to a session with `browserSettings.riskPolicyId`; Browserbase then allows or blocks each navigation by the policy's overrides, its category rules, and finally its default decision. A session keeps the policy as it was when the session started: edits, disables, and deletes apply to sessions that start afterwards. A policy checks navigations: page loads, iframes, popups, and each redirect. It doesn't check requests a page makes itself, such as scripts, images, and `fetch` calls. In a session that loads a Context, pages skip their service workers so that the policy checks every navigation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the navigation policy.

projectId.description: The project the policy belongs to.

name.description: Display name. A policy's id identifies it, not its name.

enabled.description: Whether the policy can be bound to new sessions. Running sessions keep the policy they started with. A disabled policy stays editable and can be re-enabled.

defaultDecision.description: Decision for each of a domain's categories that has no category rule. The strictest of a domain's category decisions applies, and overrides take precedence.

allowedCategories.description: Navigation categories. Browserbase blocks a domain in any blocked category, even if it is also in an allowed one.

blockedCategories.description: Navigation categories. Browserbase blocks a domain in any blocked category, even if it is also in an allowed one.

unknownDomainBehavior.description: Decision for a domain, or one of its categories, that Browserbase can't classify. It counts as one of the domain's category decisions, so the strictest still applies.

domainOverrides.description: Per-host decisions that take precedence over category rules and the default. Each host may appear once.

domain.description: Host the override applies to, for example `example.com`. Matching is case-insensitive and covers subdomains.

decision.description: Decision for navigations to this host.

type.description: Type of proxy. Always 'none' for this config.

domainPattern.description: Domain pattern for which this proxy should be used. If omitted, defaults to all domains. Optional.

concurrency.description: The maximum number of sessions that this project can run concurrently.

pageId.description: Recorded page (tab) within the session, e.g. "0", "1".

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived signed CDN URL, re-minted each GET. Present only when COMPLETED on a standard (non-BYOS) project.

completedAt.description: When the MP4 was created. Present only when COMPLETED on a standard (non-BYOS) project.

RecordingDownloadStatus.description: Per-page MP4 assembly state. `NOT_REQUESTED`: no download has been requested for the session yet. `PENDING`: assembly is enqueued or in progress. `COMPLETED`: the MP4 is ready. `FAILED`: assembly failed; POST again to retry.

secretKey.description: The name the secret value is stored under.

createdAt.description: Time at which the secret was created, in UTC, using RFC 3339 format, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00.000Z.

updatedAt.description: Time at which the secret's value was last set, in UTC, using RFC 3339 format, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00.000Z.

id.description: Identifier of the keypair the public key was minted from. Pass this back when creating a secret so the ciphertext records which keypair sealed it, which keeps decryption correct across keypair rotation.

publicKey.description: The project's HPKE public encryption key, base64-encoded. Encrypt secret values with this key before creating a secret.

projectId.description: The Project ID linked to the Session.

size.description: Size of the browser used for the session.

keepAlive.description: Indicates if the Session was created to be kept alive upon disconnections

contextId.description: Optional. The Context linked to the Session.

region.description: The region where the Session is running.

userMetadata.description: Arbitrary user metadata to attach to the session. To learn more about user metadata, see [User Metadata](/features/sessions#user-metadata).

timestamp.description: milliseconds that have elapsed since the UNIX epoch
milliseconds that have elapsed since the UNIX epoch
milliseconds that have elapsed since the UNIX epoch

Webhook.description: A delivery endpoint for a project. Browserbase POSTs a signed event to it whenever one of its subscribed event types occurs. The signing secret is returned only when it is created or rotated.

projectId.description: The project the webhook belongs to.

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that event deliveries are POSTed to. Must be publicly reachable.

eventTypes.description: Event types this webhook subscribes to. Unknown types are rejected.
